create.name: Martha Peterson
create.bio:
Martha Peterson is a certified clinical somatic educator and the founder of Essential Somatics, which she started in 2010 in Manitou Springs, Colorado. A former professional dancer, she came to somatic education after years of dance and bodywork, and her teaching builds on the work of Thomas Hanna and Moshe Feldenkrais. At its centre is pandiculation, a slow, deliberate contraction and release of muscles that helps the brain relearn how to let go of habitual tension, together with a short daily practice of gentle somatic movements done with close attention.

She teaches through online workshops and courses, week-long retreats and in-person workshops, and leads a faculty of somatic educators who run the Essential Somatics Movement Teacher Training and a longer clinical training for practitioners. She also keeps a private practice and writes widely about somatics. Her YouTube channel holds many short guided movement lessons, and she has taught several self-paced courses on The Shift Network. Outside teaching she is a keen hiker who has climbed Mount Kilimanjaro and trekked in Sikkim.

courses.title: Essential Somatics Movement Teacher Training
courses.description: A 200-hour certification for people who want to teach somatic movement lessons based on Thomas Hanna's principles. It combines in-person modules with online learning, mentoring and a practical teaching assessment, with groups in York (UK) and Arvada, Colorado.

courses.title: Essential Somatics Online Workshops
courses.description: Recorded two-hour workshops that each take one theme for a home somatic movement practice. Martha's own include Restorative Movement, Put a Spring in Your Step, Seated and Standing, Understanding Your SMA and Restful Sleep.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @EssentialSomatics 45.1K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @essentialsomatics 3,010 followers (og:description); Facebook essentialsomatics 3,203 followers (og:description) → ~51k → local_hero
flags: Her whole brand is pain relief ('Move Without Pain', 'Pain relief through movement' on the logo): all four Shift courses, her book, the card deck, Move With Ease, the free mini course and the retreats are sold on chronic pain, trauma or anxiety, so only neutral videos and two offerings remain. A human may decide she fits Spiritpedia poorly and skip her.
No subject on the list fits somatic movement well; self-healing, mindfulness and breathwork were used as the nearest.

The YouTube channel and social accounts belong to Essential Somatics (her company), not to her personally; most videos feature Martha but some may be led by other faculty, which I didn't check video by video.

The teacher training's sales page says graduates help people 'swap pain and discomfort for movement'; kept because the item is a teaching certification, not a treatment, and its description here has no claim.
The online workshops share one listing page (individual workshops have no public URLs), so they are one item; the Restful Sleep workshop is kept as sleep-as-practice.
The email info@essentialsomatics.com is the company's office address.
left_out: Shift courses: Gentle, Effective Somatic Practices to Move From Pain…, Somatic Movement & Pandiculation to Release Trapped Trauma, Somatic Freedom With the Pandiculation Technique ('reverse chronic pain', anxiety module) and Advanced Integration of Somatic Movement & Pandiculation (trauma, back and neck pain, bundles the trauma course): all health claims.
Book Move Without Pain: the title names pain.
Mindful Motion Card Deck: sold as a pain relief deck.
Move With Ease course (spring 2027) and the free Move Without Pain mini course: sold on relieving chronic pain.
Retreats (Mar de Jade, Hollyhock): sales page leads with pain and failed physiotherapy; dates not confirmed.
Clinical Somatic Education Training (CSET, $11,000): hands-on clinical protocols framed around people in pain; borderline, left out.

Other faculty's workshops (Head to Toe, Change Your Posture, Healthy Spine, Supple Neck & Shoulders, Deepening Your Practice) and Martha's Tension Reset and Pelvic Floor workshops (headaches, TMJD, pelvic pain).
Most-viewed videos named for pain or conditions (Neck and Shoulder Pain Relief, Hip Pain, Back Pain, Iliotibial Band, TMJ, Sciatica, Plantar Fasciitis, Anxiety and Stress Relief).
Daily Practice Week bundle (July 2026): multi-teacher, dated recordings.
One-to-one consultations: not her main way of working.
